channel.title: Autos and parts: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the autos and parts sector.

item.title: Orient Precision Industries: Orient Precision Industries common stock trading suspended from November 23, 2026 due to a share consolidation (reverse stock split).
Pyung Hwa Industrial: Pyeong Hwa Industry warned its common shares may be designated an administrative issue after 25 consecutive trading days closing below KRW 1,000.
SG Global: SG Global warned its common stock may be designated an administrative issue after closing below KRW 1,000 for 25 consecutive trading days.
item.description: Closing price below KRW 1,000 for 25 days

item.title: KG Eco Solution: KG Ecosolution reported Q3 2026 consolidated operating loss of KRW 22.0bn on revenue of KRW 2,030.9bn.
KG Eco Solution: KG Eco Solution reported Q3 2026 revenue of KRW 27.3bn with operating profit of KRW 7mn and a net loss of KRW 6.6bn.
Yeonghwa Metal: Youngwha Metal posted Q3 2026 preliminary revenue of KRW 89.2bn and a net loss of KRW 1.4bn on a standalone basis.
GMB Korea: GMB Korea signed a KRW 230.5bn hybrid vehicle parts supply contract with Hyundai Transys, equal to 29.3% of recent revenue.
Ajin Electronic Components: Ajin Electronics Parts reported Q3 2026 revenue of KRW 38.2bn and operating profit of KRW 2.0bn, on a separate basis.
Chasys: Chasys decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 789,473 common shares at KRW 3,800 each to Le L Partners for working capital.
Chasys: Chasys decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 1,578,947 common shares at KRW 3,800 each to Park Jong-gap, raising about KRW 6.0bn.
SNT Motiv: SNT Motiv completed its small-scale, no-new-share merger with wholly owned subsidiary SNT Robotics on November 3, 2026.
KG Mobility: KG Mobility reported Q3 2026 preliminary revenue of KRW 994.1bn and an operating loss of KRW 29.8bn on a separate basis.
SNT Dynamics: SNT Dynamics reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 143.6bn and operating profit of KRW 6.1bn, down 69.5% year on year.
SJG Sejong: SJG Sejong completed its small-scale absorption of wholly owned subsidiary SJG Central Research Institute on October 30, 2026, issuing no new shares.
item.description: Merger completed, no new shares issued
